title: London drought and Mishlove's first meeting with Owens

tellings.quote: reached out to Owens to end that drought and ended up inviting him to a conference sponsored by the Paris Science Foundation, the University of London in the summer of 76. So I met him there and befriended him

plain: During a drought in London in the summer of 1976, the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove says, someone reached out to Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic power over the weather, to end it, and Owens was invited to a conference sponsored by the Paris Science Foundation at the University of London. Mishlove tells Michels he met Owens there and became his friend, and he brings in an article from Psychic magazine and the physicists Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ, who studied psychics, as part of the background.
